title: Building permit portal
goal: Show municipal permit submission, review, and revision services.

rubric.must: Municipal Permit Portal visibly bounds the permit-related use cases.
Submit Permit Application has dashed «include» arrows pointing to Validate Property, Pay Application Fee, and Review Plans.
Request Plan Revision extends Submit Permit Application toward its incomplete plans extension point.
Validate Property and Pay Application Fee connect to distinct external actors Property Registry and Payment Service.

ideal.notes: Independent reference drawing following visual-eval/exemplars/usecase/ideal.svg (sha256 7c0fac2f9989). Vision reviewed all six rasterized targets: named subject boundary, external actors, extension-point compartments, include arrows toward included use cases and extend arrows toward bases; long dependencies routed outside unrelated ellipses. Source and rubric unchanged; no engine rendering used as target.
